entities.name: Argive
entities.description: The most northerly of the three coastal kingdoms of Terisiare on Dominaria, homeland of Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Argive lay.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A native of Argive who became Lord High Protector of the Combined Kingdoms.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A native of Argive and brother of Urza.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Combined Kingdoms
entities.description: A union of Argive, Korlis and later the remnants of Yotia, led by Urza as Lord High Protector.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: The people who resisted the Combined Kingdoms at Tomakul.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: A city the Combined Kingdoms nearly besieged.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A nation founded around 2400 AR in the area that had been Argive.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The nation formed when Kjeldor joined with Balduvia at the end of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Great-great-grandson of Jarsyl who lived in the area of former Argive until his farmstead collapsed.

events.summary: Argive joins with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms, with Urza as Lord High Protector.
events.quote: Argive joined with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms

events.summary: The Combined Kingdoms nearly besiege Tomakul but fall back before the Fallaji.
events.quote: but had to fall back due to overwhelming resistance from the Fallaji

events.summary: The Fall of Penregon in 79 AR ends the nation of Argive.
events.quote: The Fall of Penregon in 79 AR marked the end of the nation

events.summary: Kjeldor is founded in the area of the old Argive around 2400 AR.
events.quote: the nation of Kjeldor would be founded in the same area that Argive had been

relations.quote: These Combined Kingdoms had Urza as their Lord High Protector.

relations.note: Argive joined with Korlis to form it.
relations.quote: Argive joined with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms
They came very close to besieging Tomakul
